question: Which point a province's terrain is counted round.

addresses.name: CMap::LoadMapFiles
addresses.comment: Everything time.log attributes to map.cpp lines 288-636, in one body (0x489BA0..0x48B7CB, 1846 instructions, one ret). Its first act is to compute the cache stamp into CMap +0x2C (call 0x492100 at 0x489C35) and the stale flag into CMap +0x28 (call 0x4921E0 at 0x489C3E). Then: if not stale, ReadAdjacencyCache (0x48A6AC) and skip the rebuild; otherwise build the graph from the province raster (0x4911B0 at 0x48A6B6) and layer adjacencies.csv (0x48E520 at 0x48A6BC). Then 0x48F260, 0x48FAC0, the geometry pass 0x4917A0 and the positions.txt loader 0x48FBB0 - the last two unconditional, so positions.txt is reparsed every launch. Then, only when stale, the CALC_PATHS block (0x48A777) which is map.cpp:597 'calculate paths' and :605 'fix naval distances', and finally WriteAdjacencyCache (0x48AEB8), also only when stale. The single caller is InitMapLogic (rva 0x88200). **The province terrain block (rva 0x8A94D-0x8AE11), checked 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 74): the 20 x 20 count runs from the template's text point (+0x3C/+0x40, truncated) less 10 each way - for a province with no text_position the bounding-box centre less 2.0 in y - and with that every one of the 14,168 provinces' terrain as the running game holds it.
addresses.evidence: Every province template's category id read on the running game and set beside the rule; the count's loop disassembled.

struct_fields.name: text_position_y
struct_fields.comment: The y beside +0x3C, written at 0x48FE75. Paris reads 1657.5 against the file's y=1657.500000. **Where the province has no `text_position` it is the bounding-box centre y less 2.0** - (float)((double)(float)label_y - 2.0), the double at VA 0x160A360 - written by CMap::ComputeProvinceGeometry at rva 0x91926 before positions.txt is read: so such a province's near-map name stands two map pixels south of its centre (y grows northward). Hardcoded; nothing in a file moves it. CProvinceTemplate::Save treats the same value as the default it does not write. Read by ProvinceTexts_Create (rva 0x456876). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-provincenamepoint.md. **The province's terrain is counted round this point** (with +0x3C) as the map loads (CMap::LoadMapFiles, rva 0x8AA41), so a province with no text_position has its 20 x 20 square two pixels south of its centre; checked against all 14,168 provinces' terrain in the running game, 2026-11-13 (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 74). The value read later is not always the file's - 1692 provinces read otherwise in a running game - so it is written again after the terrain is counted; by what, not followed.
struct_fields.evidence: Every template's terrain set beside the count from this point; the loader's cvttss2si of +0x3C/+0x40 disassembled.
struct_fields.revises: comment: adds that the terrain is counted round this point, checked against every province
